svg.aria-label: Rulebook (parchment) design tokens, profile block and type scale
svg.text: Generated from src/index.css by scripts/design-sheet.mjs — spec §5.1–5.3
MEASURED CONTRAST — WCAG AA NEEDS 4.5:1 FOR NORMAL TEXT
CHART PALETTE (§18.3) — WCAG 1.4.11 NON-TEXT CONTRAST NEEDS 3:1
AT THE RACIAL MAXIMUM — FLAGGED, NEVER SILENTLY REFUSED
TYPE SCALE (§5.2, §5.4) — FAMILIES NAMED; SVG CANNOT LOAD THEM
Body 16px — running text sits at the §5.4 floor and no lower.
UI sans 14px — buttons, labels, table headers
Smallest permitted: 12px, and never for anything you must read to act.
